ddl:
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales (
  invoice_no   STRING,
  stock_code   STRING,
  description  STRING,
  quantity     INT,
  invoice_date STRING,
  unit_price   DOUBLE,
  customer_id  STRING,
  country      STRING
)
ROW FORMAT DELIMITED FIELDS TERMINATED BY '\t'
STORED AS TEXTFILE
LOCATION '/user/${USER}/retail/input';

queries.title: Dataset overview
queries.description: Row, order, customer, product and country counts plus total revenue.
queries.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)                                AS transactions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no)              AS orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN customer_id <> 'UNKNOWN'
                           THEN customer_id END) AS customers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT description)             AS products,
       COUNT(DISTINCT country)                 AS countries,
       SUM(quantity)                           AS units_sold,
       ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2)    AS total_revenue
FROM sales;

queries.title: Top 10 products by revenue
queries.description: Same question as MapReduce Job 1 (Sales by Product).
queries.sql:
SELECT description,
       ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM sales
GROUP BY description
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

queries.title: Revenue by country
queries.description: MapReduce Job 2 in one query, with each country's share of revenue.
queries.sql:
SELECT country,
       ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(100 * SUM(quantity * unit_price)
                 / SUM(SUM(quantity * unit_price)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct
FROM sales
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

queries.title: Top 10 products by units sold
queries.description: Same question as MapReduce Job 3 (Top-Selling Products).
queries.sql:
SELECT description,
       SUM(quantity) AS units_sold
FROM sales
GROUP BY description
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 10;

queries.title: Monthly revenue and growth
queries.description: MapReduce Job 4 plus month-over-month change using LAG().
queries.sql:
SELECT month,
       revenue,
       ROUND(100 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))
                 / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS change_pct
FROM (
  SELECT SUBSTR(invoice_date, 1, 7)           AS month,
         ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY SUBSTR(invoice_date, 1, 7)
) m
ORDER BY month;

queries.title: Top 10 customers by spend
queries.description: Biggest customers, their order count and the country they buy from.
queries.sql:
SELECT customer_id,
       country,
       COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no)           AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2) AS total_spent
FROM sales
WHERE customer_id <> 'UNKNOWN'
GROUP BY customer_id, country
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 10;

queries.title: Average order value by country
queries.description: Revenue per order, for countries with at least 20 orders.
queries.sql:
SELECT country,
       COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM sales
GROUP BY country
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) >= 20
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

queries.title: Sales by hour of day
queries.description: When during the day customers place their orders.
queries.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(invoice_date, 12, 2) AS INT) AS hour,
       COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no)               AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2)     AS revenue
FROM sales
GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR(invoice_date, 12, 2) AS INT)
ORDER BY hour;
